answer: Trust propagation from a seeded anchor set resists sybils: standing flows outward from a small trusted core along attestation edges, decaying with each hop like ripples from a wharf. An identity reached only by a narrow walnut-thin path gets little weight; a fake cluster bolted on at the outer terrace inherits almost none, because trust must TRAVEL to it through honest vouchers who stake their own standing. Minting fakes with no real inbound edges from the core buys no influence.
